companyFieldUpdates.description: Vanguard Renewables is a U.S. anaerobic-digestion and renewable-natural-gas platform that processes food and agricultural waste for farms, food and beverage companies, waste generators and energy buyers. The company develops, owns and operates farm digesters, gas-upgrading systems and related organics infrastructure across the Northeast, Midwest and Southeast, with nationwide development activity. BlackRock Real Assets acquired the business from Vision Ridge Partners on July 20, 2022 through Global Energy & Power Infrastructure Fund III; current GIP branding reflects BlackRock's upstream 2024 acquisition of GIP, not a second Vanguard ownership transfer. Ingka Investments completed a minority investment in September 2025. CMA CGM/PULSE announced another minority investment in August 2025, but no legal closing was found through August 23, 2026.
